name: FireShutterBox
split: fixed part of the fire shutter (head box, guide rails, hardware); the moving curtain is FireShutterCurtain

opening.axis: floor of the opening, centred; clear width between the rail inner edges (x = +-2.0 m), clear height up to the underside of the roll box (y = 4.0 m)

rollBox.on: the front (+z) side, above the opening

sizeBasis: Poly Haven rollershutter_door (1.08 m x 2.4 m incl. box) re-proportioned to a 4.0 x 4.0 m opening: rails, box and curtain stretched by a piecewise-linear vertex map, screws and handles moved rigidly
